note: OsmAnd (net.osmand / net.osmand.plus). OsmAnd puts the whole step in the notification TITLE as '<distance> • <instruction>' (BigTextStyle; text/subText null); the distance is the leading number+unit. Capture-confirmed fixtures (source=capture) are from a real en FULL export (2026-08): only turn-left/right and the '0 m • ' at-maneuver + download/index non-nav states were observed. Synthetic fixtures exercise the maneuvers authored from OsmAnd's known English phrasing (roundabout, U-turn, keep, slight, sharp, continue, arrive), to be re-pinned as source=capture as real captures arrive.
